svg.title: The Incan build engine: processes and stores
svg.desc: Five client kinds send typed requests to one engine service per physical bakery. Capture reads only the editable inputs a request reaches: root sources and the files their recorded lookups resolve to, loaf.toml and the lock with their vocabularies and toolchain pin, and Rust and C source in the Loaf through the same graph plus the compiler's dependency report; it checks them metadata first and hashes only candidates, while unrelated sibling files are never read. The engine ranks and schedules work, claims and publishes results, manages leases and cancellation, and records traces. Record workers run the compiler producers, including doc and position records, Rust inspection, C declarations and RFC 097 caller facets, and a rustc worker compiles native units; both read the store directly through mapped, keyed reads. Five kinds of virtual store select copy-on-write binding roots over one physical IncQL-DB bakery made of manifest, index pages, segments, payloads, staging, leases, claim locks and roots. Toolchain bundles, local and registry Loaves, local bakes and registry assets enter only through verified admission and are frozen once admitted, never re-checked. Program and test processes run exact payloads under execution pins.
svg.text: launched by the CLI or runner
